_doc: Assumed economics for datacenter_v1 (GPU-rental neocloud: hourly + reserved clusters). Every value is 'assumed' and carries its basis.

retention_sensitivity_per_health_point.basis: assumed: usage-based and short reserved terms let revenue move quickly with utilization and reliability; a 50-point health span is taken to move 12-month revenue by ~25% of the base, i.e. 0.5% per point

revenue_at_risk_share_by_band.basis: assumed: share of the account's annualized rental revenue expected to be lost within the horizon (workloads migrated, reservations not renewed), by health band; low switching cost in GPU rental
